description:
**Test build for #212 — not a release.** Netflix ad-strip fix candidate (MASTER v3). Built from branch `fix/netflix-212-getadmetadata-branch` (commit e248a3e) on top of v1.37.7.

**What changed:** `getAdMetadata` now empties its ad-break list on *every* branch, including the new `adverts.adBreaks` branch that leaked on 13.0.1. Only the Netflix ad-kill script changed.

**How to test** (Netflix 13.0.1 build 25028):
1. Patch with `test-212.mpp` using the same patches as before (Clone Netflix, Disable CertCheck, Remove Netflix ads bundle engine + loader).
2. Install, launch, wait ~60s on the home screen, then play an ad-tier title.
3. Attach `adb logcat -d -s KILL > kill.txt`. Look for `PATCH M2: ... else{};b=[];` or `PATCH MASTERw: ... v3`.

Verified offline (patch applies, script bundled, branch logic simulated). Not yet verified on a device — that's what this build is for.
